title.en: Endogenous detection before capture lock and split evidence
title.zh: 捕获锁定前之内生检测与分裂证据

statement.en: An observation-only learner switching a pool hits ClosedCapture's window: locked if outnumbered when read, turning permanently if not outnumbered next step, or alternating/exiting across the middle band by order. Under one-time-mask split evidence, sound local filters stall while exchange turns.
statement.zh: 仅读回报之学习者切换他者池读，恰落封闭捕获窗口：读时载体已不少即锁，次步不占优则永转，中段依序交替或出离为两锁。一次掩码分裂证据下，局部可靠警报归零，交换一位则转。

hypotheses.en: No Lean axiom. Discrete steps; Moore-machine learner reading only primary task return; majority admission gate on CarrierCounts; two-kind unnormalized Drawn.pool; mirror reading for others after registration; one-bit mask split streams over binary tag prefixes.
hypotheses.zh: 无 Lean 公理。离散步；仅读原任务回报之摩尔机学习者；基于载体计数之多数准入闸门；两类未归一化之阅读池；登记后他者取镜像阅读；基于二进制标签前缀之单位掩码分裂流。

laws.en: Gate and lockout: where intended restraint is admitted, the gated course matches the closed orbit (gated_eq_closed); once locked out, stock follows pure extraction regardless of what any learner intends or registers (lockout_pure_extract, lockout_learner_irrelevant).
laws.zh: 闸门与锁定：凡欲节制处获准入，受闸进程即合无闸轨道（gated_eq_closed）；一旦锁定，无论学习者欲何或登记何，存量皆归纯抽取（lockout_pure_extract、lockout_learner_irrelevant）。

laws.en: Pre-capture turning window for any reading cadence: whenever registration holds from step tau, share and rule match Thinned.course with loss bound tau (mark_eq_thinned), giving exact capture lock-in (mark_kept_iff, mark_kept_locks_out) and exact cadence-general admission (mark_turned_iff, mark_turned_admits_iff).
laws.zh: 任意阅读节奏下之捕获前转向窗口：凡登记自第 tau 步起成立，份额与规则即合阈值 tau 之稀释历程（mark_eq_thinned），给出精确锁定（mark_kept_iff、mark_kept_locks_out）与任意节奏下之精确准入充要条件（mark_turned_iff、mark_turned_admits_iff）。

laws.en: Alternating middle band and order partition: reading states split four ways (reading_state_four_way, middle_disjoint_locked); spans from MiddleMinus or MiddlePlus step to opposite middle states or exit to permanent lock (mark_middle_minus_span, mark_middle_plus_span, mark_middle_band_trichotomy), monotone in initial share (mark_middle_band_monotone_partition), with 4 witnesses.
laws.zh: 交替中段与单调划分：阅读态四分；每段自中段跃迁为对偶或永锁（mark_middle_minus_span、mark_middle_plus_span、mark_middle_band_trichotomy），对初份额单调（mark_middle_band_monotone_partition），含4组见证。

laws.en: Six separating witnesses for emergentLoop: timely turn (race_in_time), late registration after lock-in (race_late_after_registration), probe blocked (race_probe_blocked), strain masked one step longer (race_masked_strain), cadence separation under PacedStock.ReadAtSpanEnd (race_slow_cadence, race_fast_cadence, cadence3_readAtSpanEnd), and exogenous control (race_exo_no_false_turn).
laws.zh: 涌现学习者之六组分离见证：及时转向、迟登记仍锁、探针被阻、应变被掩（race_in_time 至 race_masked_strain）、阅读节奏决定存亡（cadence3_readAtSpanEnd、race_slow_cadence、race_fast_cadence）及外生对照（race_exo_no_false_turn）。

laws.en: Split-evidence marginal conservation and exchange coupling: retag involution preserves all 2^T tag counts (retag_symmetry, count_view_invariant, split_marginal_count_eq), trapping sound consensus in closed capture (silencing_consensus, split_silenced_trapped) while raw verdicts leak (verdict_leak) and one-bit exchange turns selection (exchange_detects, split_exchange_turns, split_witness_endo).
laws.zh: 分裂证据之边际守恒与交换耦合：重标对合守恒全部 2^T 标签计数（count_view_invariant、split_marginal_count_eq），令局部可靠共识锁于封闭池（split_silenced_trapped），非可靠裁决泄证（verdict_leak），单位交换令选择转向（split_exchange_turns、split_witness_endo）。

laws.en: Observation-only emergence prerequisite: emergentLoop shifts endogenous weights over returning support under non-myopic return (endogenous_emergence_sufficiency), lifts onto MasterSpine via (n+1)-step GuardedProof (item12_endogenous_emergence_and_oplax_master_bridge), and breaks universally when sensory strain, two-step probing, or width fails.
laws.zh: 仅读回报之内生涌现前提：emergentLoop 于非近视回报下调整自返权重（endogenous_emergence_sufficiency）并经 (n+1) 步 GuardedProof 接至主干（item12_endogenous_emergence_and_oplax_master_bridge），缺感官应变、两步探针或宽度则普适失效。

does_not_show.en: CarrierCounts turning does not ensure stock survival on coarser cadences if intermediate lockouts drain stock first (replay R5 L=3,4); Part B fixes the depletion stream beforehand over uniform 2^T tags.
does_not_show.zh: 粗阅读节奏下，即便载体计数最终转向，若此前受锁跨度已耗尽存量，仍不保底物存活（见回放 R5 L=3,4）；乙部仍假定耗竭流先定且均匀计 2^T 标签。

does_not_show.en: Endogenous registration remains confined to self-returning continuation and leaves one-way downstream dependents unranked (emergent_order_firewall).
does_not_show.zh: 内生登记仅及于自返之相续，不赋予单向受累者任何位序（emergent_order_firewall）。

not_required.en: No exogenous alarm, threshold constant, or regime label is read by the learner.
not_required.zh: 学习者不读取任何外生警报、阈值常数或体制标签。

validation_scope.zh: AI-written；lean-check 验明 Becoming.EndogenousEmergence（42 定理、100 声明）与 Becoming.EndogenousDetectionRace（94 定理、137 声明）空公理（becoming-checks/20261124T184422.177368Z）；纯标准库回放随 evidence-replay 通过 15/15（含 R5 中段三分与单调性）。

next_delta.zh: 由 Ren 审读；将乙部推至掩码与底物闭环耦合及非均匀标签分布。

detail.en: ClosedCapture.Thinned treats the threshold N at which others read the loss as a parameter; here N is derived from an observation-only learner registration step.
detail.zh: ClosedCapture.Thinned 以他者读损阈值 N 为外参；此处 N 由仅读回报学习者之登记步内生导出。

detail.en: Uses ClosedCapture.Thinned and ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss with N derived from registration step tau.
Instantiates PacedStock.ReadAtSpanEnd at cadence 3 in cadence3_readAtSpanEnd.
EndogenousEmergence bridges onto MasterSpine.WholeArchitecture via (n + 1)-step GuardedProof.
